name: dsh-crew
description: The crew for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a spine session on the crew-spine preset runs ossify's run-spine --external-executor, dispatching each work item to a configured subagent_implementer child, verifying it with a subagent_verifier child, computing ossify's result record from git and handing the round back; an orchestrator outside dsh spawns, steers and hands off those sessions through the dsh web API. ossify state is the single authority; this plugin adds nothing to its contract. Three prose skills (dsh-executor, dsh-brief, dsh-session), the crew-spine preset as files, and a reference for the operator's dsh home. Each project chooses a model per crew role in .dsh-crew/roles.md. No lib, no state, no commands.

interface.shortDescription: Run ossify spines inside DeepSeek Harness
interface.longDescription: A spine session in DeepSeek Harness runs ossify's run-spine --external-executor, dispatching each work item to a configured implementer child tool and verifying it with a configured verifier child tool; an orchestrator outside dsh spawns and steers those sessions through the dsh web API. ossify state stays the single authority; the plugin ships prose skills and preset files only and adds nothing to ossify's contract.
